messages:
anna-docs: Hey team — I opened a docs PR to add inline k8s/Helm examples for audit log retention & KMS integration so infra teams can copy/paste. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
sam-legal: Thanks for the ping. Can you highlight anywhere we changed SOC2 phrasing? Legal needs to sign off on any wording about retention/consent.
mike-security: Quick skim: the Helm values example exposes a boolean called `send_audit_to_external` — please don't suggest plaintext sinks. We should show a secure KMS config sample instead.
anna-docs: Good catch. Current PR has a basic values.yaml snippet. Thinking of replacing this block with an encrypted k8s secret + KMS example. Draft in thread:

```
# values.yaml
audit:
  enabled: true
  retention_days: 365
  sink: s3://redwood-audit-bucket
  encryption:
    provider: aws-kms
    key_id: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd"
```

jules-devex: Suggestion: show how to template the KMS key via Helm values and reference a Kubernetes Secret for credentials instead of hardcoding. Example:

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: audit-credentials
stringData:
  aws_access_key_id: {{ .Values.kms.access_key }}
  aws_secret_access_key: {{ .Values.kms.secret }}
```

sam-legal: Also: replace `retention_days: 365` with language that we "recommend" a retention policy and link to SOC2-approved retention schedule. Don't state it's a requirement. Use wording like: "Recommended retention period for audit logs: 365 days; confirm with compliance team for regulated data."
mike-security: Also add note about access controls and audit log pseudonymization. For the docs snippet, something short under the example: `# Ensure PII is pseudonymized before storage`.
anna-docs: I'll update the PR with (a) KMS templated example, (b) secret pattern, (c) softened SOC2 phrasing, and (d) a short note about pseudonymization. Will tag legal for a final review.
deploy-bot: build succeeded for docs PR 482 — checks/helm-lint passed :white_check_mark:
jules-devex: One more ask — can we include a tiny Go SDK example showing how to set the `audit.retention_days` via the API when provisioning? Many infra folks copy that. Something like:

```
client.SetAuditConfig(ctx, &AuditConfig{RetentionDays: 365, KmsKey: os.Getenv("KMS_KEY")})
```

sam-legal: Once updated, ping me and I'll run through the phrasing. If legal approves, we can merge.
anna-docs: Updated PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482/files — changed wording per legal, added KMS secret example, added a short pseudonymization note, and a Go snippet. PTAL @sam-legal @mike-security
mike-security: LGTM for security content. Small nit: change comment to `# Avoid storing raw PII in audit logs; pseudonymize or redact where possible`.
sam-legal: I reviewed the new wording and it's acceptable for SOC2 references. Left one tiny suggestion to avoid the word "must". Once that's in, I'm good to approve.
anna-docs: Done — replaced `must` with `we recommend` in two places. Merging after checks finish. Thanks everyone! :tada:

deploy-bot: docs PR 482 merged to main — deploy to staging queued.
